---
title: "Bigger Picture documentation"
---

Bigger Picture is an individual participant data (IPD) meta-analysis of the relationship between screen use and child and adolescent outcomes.
This site documents the data pipeline that ingests, tidies, and harmonises the contributing datasets, and the [evidence platform](platform/index.qmd) that presents the project's findings to teachers.
The pipeline itself lives in the [`bigger_picture` repository](https://github.com/Motivation-and-Behaviour/bigger_picture); the scientific background and planned analyses are in the [preregistration](prereg/bigger_picture_preregistration.pdf).

## Where to start

If you are preparing a dataset for the project, work through the guides in order:

1. [Getting started](guides/getting-started.qmd) — install the tools and get access to the data.
2. [Adding a dataset](guides/adding-a-dataset.qmd) — the end-to-end workflow, from picking a dataset to submitting a pull request.
3. [The dataset.yaml spec](guides/dataset-yaml.qmd) — every field explained, plus how to validate your spec.
4. [Spec cookbook](guides/spec-cookbook.qmd) — copy-paste patterns for common dataset layouts (multiple files, waves, nested folders, and every reader).
5. [Tidy scripts](guides/tidy-scripts.qmd) — turning raw resources into one tidy table.
6. [Harmonising variables](guides/harmonisation.qmd) — mapping a tidied dataset onto the project dataschema.

## Writing evidence summaries

If you are writing or updating evidence summaries for the [Bigger Picture evidence platform](https://motivation-and-behaviour.github.io/bigger-picture-platform/), start with [The evidence platform](platform/index.qmd), then work through:

1. [Adding a summary](platform/adding-a-summary.qmd) — the end-to-end checklist, from gathering the evidence to a published page.
2. [Summary fields](platform/summary-fields.qmd) — every Airtable table and field, explained.
3. [Rating the evidence](platform/rating-the-evidence.qmd) — the rubric for the impact and evidence-quality ratings.
4. [Writing guide](platform/writing-guide.qmd) — writing for teachers, choosing sources, and a checklist to run before publishing.
5. [Publishing and fixing problems](platform/publishing.qmd) — the Publish button, and what each Sync status and Sync message means.
6. [Updating a summary](platform/updating-a-summary.qmd) — adding new evidence, re-rating, and taking a summary off the site.

## Reference

- [Dataschema](reference/dataschema.qmd) — a searchable table of every harmonised variable, generated from `harmonisation/dataschema.csv`.
- [Harmonisation progress](reference/progress.qmd) — which datasets are in the pipeline and how far along each variable mapping is.
- [Decision register](decisions/README.md) — records of key project decisions and why they were made.
